notes: Added missing schema and expiration/rotation orchestration stories to complete lifecycle coverage.

stories.title: Token Schema and Storage Contract Definition
stories.description: Define and implement the token persistence schema including fields for token_id, hashed_token, issued_at, expires_at, rotation_parent_id, revocation_status, and audit metadata. Ensure compatibility with MongoDB patterns used in GPTReader and Shared utilities.

stories.title: Token Expiration Enforcement Logic
stories.description: Implement expiration validation logic to reject tokens past expires_at, including configurable TTL and clock-skew tolerance. Expired tokens must be logged and denied at authentication time.

stories.title: Token Rotation Logic and Lineage Tracking
stories.description: Implement secure token rotation including generation of new tokens, invalidation or sunset of prior tokens, and linkage via rotation_parent_id for audit traceability. Ensure no reuse of prior tokens and enforce single active token policy if configured.
